mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a comfortable 77 degrees near the Verona Public Library. The full moon is out tonight, and the ISS will be visible rising in the west over Mount Horeb at 3:25 AM, heading toward the northeast. The overnight low will be 61 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city has a few updates to share. September is now recognized as National Senior Center Month, honoring our older residents. Additionally, the Senior Center is rolling out a new tri-shaw bike program where you can take a free ride on the Military Ridge State Trail, and they continue to offer a variety of daily meal options and exercise classes to keep our community active.

There is plenty to do in town over the next few days. Today you can enjoy music at Paddy Mac's, trivia at the Bogey Factory, or the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park. Tomorrow, check out trivia at Hop Haus, and later this week we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, followed by the kids triathlon this Saturday.

Regarding local public safety, on Thursday, August 20, officers handled several routine calls, and specifically on August 22, a driver was cited in the 1200 block of Enterprise Drive for multiple violations including inattentive driving and operating after revocation.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the crowd-pleasing Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant is currently open, so make sure to stop by before they close their doors at 10:00 PM.
